key_light.frame: wall-local: az 0 = from image-right, 90 = from above; el from the wall plane

ambient.why: median of truth luma / flat luma over the pixels where the page's N-pass extended source delivers no direct light, measured on this room's own Blender truth render (default composition as real displaced geometry); same method for every room

panel_albedo.why: Base Color of the Blender material 'placeholder' that the plate's feature-wall panel was rendered with (room_scene.py RHO_PLACEHOLDER, linear RGB 0.5,0.5,0.5, Principled BSDF, roughness 0.9). The page tints the plate by swatch_linear / this, so a swatch of albedo 0.5 reproduces the plate unchanged. The room light is not altered.

note.tr: Klinik resepsiyonu, karşı duvar (3200 × 1600 mm panel, zeminden 900 mm); ışık: sol duvarda yan pencere, tavandan yumuşak dağınık ışık.
note.en: Clinic reception, facing wall (3200 × 1600 mm panel, 900 mm above the floor); light: side window, left wall, soft ceiling fill.

scale_cues.why: camera-projected through the Blender render camera (room_scene.py cues_px), plate pixels. wall_width: horizontal string 100 mm under the panel's lower edge, on the wall plane; counter_height: vertical string at the counter's front edge depth, floor to counter top; figure: a 1.8 m standing figure, floor point + head point, at the stated distance from the wall plane.

key_extent_deg.why: key_D is a Blender AREA RECTANGLE 0.9 x 2.4 m at the wall; 81 emitter samples seen from the panel centre in the wall frame; half-extent = (max - min) / 2 per axis. The page jitters over this az/el box (the emitter's az-el correlation is dropped).
